Glider deployments by the NOAA Southwest Fisheries Science Center (SWFSC) Ecosystem
Science Division (ESD) Glider Team. Deployments around the South Shetland Islands and the
Antarctic Peninsula are from NOAA's Antarctic Marine Living Resources (AMLR) program.
Filter the map by start year or deployment name (and by region once more than one region
has data); click a track and choose
**Open 3D curtain** to explore temperature, salinity, chlorophyll and oxygen along that
deployment.
